name: Hanoi
tagline: Lake walks, street kitchens and layered history
summary: Use the Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem as a compact arrival base. Reserve separate time for the western heritage sights and add a multi-day side trip to Ninh Binh or Ha Long when your schedule permits.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are often comfortable; winter can be grey and damp, and summer is hot and rainy.
arrival: Noi Bai is well outside the centre; airport bus or a booked taxi can take about an hour or more in traffic.
gettingAround: Walk short clusters; use booked cars for longer trips and cross roads calmly without sudden direction changes.
cashTip: Vietnamese dong cash is essential at many stalls; check note denominations carefully.
foodTip: Try bun cha, pho and egg coffee; many broths and sauces contain meat or fish.
buyTip: Buy coffee, tea or locally made lacquerware; compare quality and carry breakables carefully.
baseArea: Old Quarter edge for walkability with less overnight noise.
